assets.name: wall-plaster
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production tileable game albedo texture, single square image 1024x1024, flat full-frame surface with no perspective. Primary request: original worn hotel plaster, dark-coop-horror low-poly art direction reminiscent of tactile grimy late-1990s industrial games. Muted pale grey with a subtle sickly olive tint, layered old paint, sparse peeling flecks, rubbed areas, small hairline cracks, uneven damp discoloration. Broad hand-painted forms and restrained coarse grain, not photographic micro-noise. Midtone base around 65 percent brightness so engine lighting can darken it. Seamlessly tile on ALL four edges, evenly distributed detail, no central subject or vignette. Diffuse albedo only: neutral even illumination, NO baked shadows, highlights, light source, room, panels, border, objects, text, logo or watermark. A single material swatch, not a contact sheet.
